# UE JSON Template Notes

Use this as a planning skeleton before editing actual JSON.

```text
Block ID:
Title:
Resource Type:
Component Pattern: [single block | block + item]
Required fields:
Optional fields:
Field components per property:
Conditional fields (with controlling field):
Validation rules:
Model ID:
Filter ID:
Filter updates needed:

```

After editing `_block.json` and related models, run `npm run build:json`.
